مَحِلٌّ : see مَحَلٌّ. ―
-b2- Also The lawful place of slaughter of a beast for sacrifice; (S;) accord. to some, to the pilgrim on the general day of sacrifice, and to the performer of the عُمْرَة on the day of his entering Mekkeh; or, as others say, to him who is in the state of إِحْرَام. (TA.) ―
-b3- And The term, or period, of falling due of a debt. (S, TA.) ＝
-A2- It is also an inf. n. (K, TA. [See 1.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
